from pathlib import Path
import argparse,subprocess,json,hashlib,statistics,time,fcntl,resource,random
p=Path(__file__).parent;r=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env');old=Path('/tmp/sirkit_rh_20261022');parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--variants',nargs='+',default=['baseline','control','bytes']);parser.add_argument('--rounds',type=int,default=7);parser.add_argument('--name',default='bytes-main');parser.add_argument('--compiler',choices=['gcc','clang'],default='gcc');parser.add_argument('--fallback',action='store_true');parser.add_argument('--all',action='store_true');parser.add_argument('--disable-simd',action='store_true');args=parser.parse_args();sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
driver=(r/'Verify/current/drivers/rolling_hash_zalgorithm_main.cpp').read_text();io=(r/'Verify/current/common/fast_io.hpp').read_text();main=driver.replace('#include "Verify/current/common/fast_io.hpp"',io)
cc=['/usr/bin/g++']if args.compiler=='gcc'else['/usr/bin/clang++','--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15'];flags=['-std=c++23','-O2',*(['-U__SIZEOF_INT128__','-DSIRKIT_FORCE_STANDARD_ARITHMETIC','-DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD']if args.fallback else ['-march=native','-DEVAL','-DONLINE_JUDGE']if args.compiler=='gcc'else[])];refs={}
if args.disable_simd:flags+=['-DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD']
for inp in sorted((old/'official').glob('*.in')):
 if not args.all and inp.name not in ['all_same_00.in','binary_carry_00.in','random_00.in','random_01.in','random_02.in','periodic_00.in','periodic_01.in']:continue
 out=old/'reference_outputs'/(inp.name+'.out');assert out.exists();refs[inp.name]={'input':str(inp),'input_sha256':sha(inp.read_bytes()),'output_sha256':sha(out.read_bytes())}
assert refs
builds=[]
for v in args.variants:
 if v=='control':continue
 body=p/(v+'.hpp');tu=p/(args.name+'-'+v+'.cpp');tu.write_text('#define SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n'+body.read_text()+main);cmd=['taskset','-c','6',*cc,*flags,str(tu),'-o',str(p/(args.name+'-'+v))];q=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);assert q.returncode==0,q.stderr;builds.append(dict(variant=v,cmd=cmd,source_sha256=sha(body.read_bytes()),diagnostics=q.stderr))
data={v:{c:[]for c in refs}for v in args.variants};rng=random.Random(190207)
with open('/tmp/sirkit_performance_cpu14.lock','a')as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
 for rep in range(args.rounds):
  for c,ref in refs.items():
   vs=list(args.variants);rng.shuffle(vs)
   for v in vs:
    exe=p/(args.name+'-'+('baseline'if v=='control'else v));out=p/(args.name+'.out')
    with Path(ref['input']).open('rb')as inp,out.open('wb')as f:
     before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);start=time.perf_counter_ns();q=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','14',str(exe)],stdin=inp,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.PIPE);wall=(time.perf_counter_ns()-start)/1e6;after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    assert q.returncode==0 and not q.stderr and sha(out.read_bytes())==ref['output_sha256'],(v,c,q.stderr)
    cpu=(after.ru_utime+after.ru_stime-before.ru_utime-before.ru_stime)*1000;data[v][c].append(dict(wall_ms=wall,cpu_ms=cpu))
  print('round',rep,flush=True)
med={v:{c:statistics.median(x['cpu_ms']for x in xs)for c,xs in cs.items()}for v,cs in data.items()};res={'raw':data,'median_ms':med,'ratio':{v:{c:med[v][c]/med['baseline'][c]for c in refs}for v in args.variants},'builds':builds,'driver_sha256':sha(driver.encode()),'io_sha256':sha(io.encode()),'fixtures':refs};(p/(args.name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(res,indent=2));print(json.dumps({'median_ms':med,'ratio':res['ratio']},indent=2),flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,time,resource,json,statistics,random,hashlib,fcntl
p=Path(__file__).parent;original=json.loads((p/'redundant-main.json').read_text());cases=['all_same_02.in','fib_str_01.in'];raw={v:{c:[]for c in cases}for v in ['baseline','control','redundant']};rng=random.Random(251118)
with open('/tmp/sirkit_performance_cpu14.lock','a')as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
 for rep in range(31):
  for c in cases:
   vs=list(raw);rng.shuffle(vs)
   for v in vs:
    ref=original['fixtures'][c];out=p/'recheck.out';exe=p/('redundant-main-'+('baseline'if v=='control'else v))
    with Path(ref['input']).open('rb')as inp,out.open('wb')as f:
     b=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);st=time.perf_counter_ns();q=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','14',str(exe)],stdin=inp,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.PIPE);elapsed=(time.perf_counter_ns()-st)/1e6;a=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    assert q.returncode==0 and not q.stderr and hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==ref['output_sha256'];raw[v][c].append(dict(wall_ms=elapsed,cpu_ms=(a.ru_utime+a.ru_stime-b.ru_utime-b.ru_stime)*1000))
med={v:{c:statistics.median(x['cpu_ms']for x in xs)for c,xs in cs.items()}for v,cs in raw.items()};rat={v:{c:med[v][c]/med['baseline'][c]for c in cases}for v in raw};(p/'recheck-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(raw=raw,median_ms=med,ratio=rat),indent=2));print(rat)

reproduction: sourceヘッダと各スクリプトを取り出し、作業パスとCPU番号を環境へ合わせる。固定main入力は過去に保存したLibrary Checker Z Algorithm公式29件、正解は独立な線形Z法。I/Oやmainは変えない。op_benchはOPごとの翻訳単位とし、n/op/baseを引数で渡す。
selection_hardware_scope: ユーザーの追加指示によりP-Coreのみを採否・改善率の根拠とする。
reference_fixture_note: 入出力生成器や外部実装のソースは新しく同梱しない。既存のfixtureと照合hashを性能記録へ保存する。
